references.text: The people were amazed at Jesus' miracles and asked if he could be David's son, reflecting the Psalms' expectation of a mighty descendant of David.
Isaiah's prophecy about one who comes to heal and perform miracles, which the people see in Jesus and ask if he is David's son.
Another event where Jesus heals and the people wonder if he is David's son.
The people hailed Jesus as David's son when he rode into Jerusalem, showing their expectation that he is the Messiah.
Jesus himself questions the identity of the Messiah as David's son, reflecting the people's question in Matthew 12:23.
